description: sudo env_keep preserves PATH, and a root-owned helper calls an unqualified binary, enabling PATH hijack to root.
detailed_description: The lowpriv user may invoke /usr/local/sbin/admin_check.sh via sudo without a password. The helper script calls `df` with no absolute path, and sudoers retains PATH from the caller via `env_keep += "PATH"`. An attacker places an attacker-controlled `df` binary earlier in PATH; when root runs the helper, the shadow binary executes as root and can drop a SUID shell.
